item.title: Agricultural land management practices in the conterminous United States from 1980–2023
item.description:
Agricultural land management practices in the conterminous United States from 1980–2023
Lauren Hoskovec, Stephen M. Ogle, F. Jay Breidt, Alisa R. Keyser, Teng Liu, Yesar Ahmed Oshan, Shannon L. Spencer, and Stephen Williams
Earth Syst. Sci. Data, 18, 8441–8469, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-18-8441-2026, 2026
We compiled a history of agricultural land management practices for the conterminous United States from 1980–2023. Our product depicts earlier and later planting dates for certain crops, increased use of cover crops, increased synthetic fertilizer and manure Nitrogen application, and shifts towards reduced tillage intensities over time. The data set can inform agricultural studies regarding greenhouse gas emissions, environmental impacts, and food production.

item.title: A new high-resolution daily mean South China Sea Ocean Reanalysis dataset: SCSORA
item.description:
A new high-resolution daily mean South China Sea Ocean Reanalysis dataset: SCSORA
Xuri Zhang, Xueming Zhu, Ziqing Zu, Guokun Lv, Hailong Wang, Yan Yan, Jian Liu, and Hui Wang
Earth Syst. Sci. Data, 18, 8471–8495, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-18-8471-2026, 2026
This research presents a high-resolution ocean reanalysis dataset for the South China Sea covering 2001 to 2024. The dataset assimilates satellite remote sensing data and in-situ observations. It provides daily mean three-dimensional fields of temperature, salinity, currents, and sea surface height. Validation results show good agreement with observations. The dataset has been used to support studies of marine heatwaves, mesoscale eddies, and related processes in this important region.

item.title: MacroTraits: a global trait data and information system for marine benthic ecology
item.description:
MacroTraits: a global trait data and information system for marine benthic ecology
Olivier Beauchard and Karline Soetaert
Earth Syst. Sci. Data, 18, 8497–8535, https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-18-8497-2026, 2026
MacroTraits is a global trait data and information system of the marine zoobenthos. Based on a detailed terminology, the database provides fuzzy-coded data of 41 traits that cover habitat, life cycle, dwelling mode and ecosystem function for 1893 macro- and megabenthic species. Theoretical relevance supports the use of these data in functional ecology such as species assembly rules and exploration of ecosystem functions. This rich documentation enables worldwide comparative studies.

item.title: Extending the NASA Ozone Column Retrievals to NOAA-20 OMPS: A Consistent NOAA-20 OMPS Total Column Ozone Data Record for 2018–2026
item.description:
Extending the NASA Ozone Column Retrievals to NOAA-20 OMPS: A Consistent NOAA-20 OMPS Total Column Ozone Data Record for 2018–2026
Kanghyun Baek, Can Li, Natalya A. Kramarova, Gordon J. Labow, Glen Jaross, Bradford L. Fisher, Jerry R. Zimeke, and Stacey M. Frith
Earth Syst. Sci. Data Discuss., https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2026-802,2026
Preprint under review for ESSD (discussion: open, 0 comments)
Ozone in the stratosphere protects life from harmful ultraviolet radiation, making reliable long-term observations essential for tracking its recovery. Here we describe a new global total ozone dataset from the Ozone Mapping and Profiler Suite aboard the NOAA-20 satellite. The dataset agrees closely with measurements from the earlier Suomi satellite and ground-based instruments and can help continue NASA’s long-term monitoring of the ozone layer from space.
